description.value:
A searing line of Force-fed flame, 30 feet long and 5 feet wide, blazes outward from you in a direction of your choosing. Every creature caught in the line must attempt a Dexterity saving throw, taking 3d8 energy damage on a failure or half that amount on a success.

Cast with a slot of 3rd level or higher, the flame's damage grows by 1d8 for every slot level above 2nd.
